Keisha (CS): Heads-up from Boreal onboarding - they flipped to compact-int8 for chat + embeddings and saw intermittent 10-15% p99 spikes.
Marco (SE): Noted. Any traffic shape change?
Keisha (CS): Yes, new long-doc flow increased token count for ~12% of calls.
Anya (ML): int8 + longer contexts usually raises KV churn and sometimes triggers slower kernels.
Marco (SE): Quick suggestion: route requests with >300 tokens to fp16, enable prefix KV for the chat route, and run a 3% fp16 canary for 15m. Short snippet to paste:
```
routing:
  rules:
    - when: request.tokens > 300
      route_to: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
```
Anya (ML): Also capture 50 sample generations from both paths for regression checks.
Keisha (CS): I'll message Boreal and schedule the canary. Will update thread with telemetry.
